# Reading time (community)

Counts the words of a page on save (`page.before.save`) and stores `{ words, minutes }` under `metadata.plugins.reading-time`, a declared metadata field. `render.before.content` puts the label ("{n} min read") above the content.

- Settings: `wordsPerMinute` (200), `label`.

<!-- implements:start (generated by scripts/plugin-docs.mjs from plugin.yaml and the docblocks in the code; do not edit by hand) -->
## What it implements

| Kind | Name | Runs when | What this plugin does |
|---|---|---|---|
| hook | `page.before.save` | page content or metadata is about to be written (editor save, CLI, import) | Counts the words of the page and stores the word count and reading time in metadata.plugins.reading-time, so themes and the render hook can show it without counting again. |
| hook | `render.before.content` | the page content is about to be placed in the shell | Puts a short reading-time line above the page content, using the minutes stored at save time and the label setting. |

Each code row matches a docblock (`Implements hook ...`, `Implements operation ...`) directly above the implementation in `src/nodejs` and `src/php`.
